content: Genekashlu giwekachri

Giyagni, nomolene, nagjitgi Goyakalu getwamonrewle chinanu giylatkalurunepa pixkalungi genekmanetinwa genekashlupa giwekachri, kpashiri, Goyakalu gigleretanru. Walenwa gkamrure potukalu potu Goyakalu yegi.
Gi wa tyegogne gajene pixka gixanu, seyni pnuko gixinwa gerotewanshinikankaakalungi nchininri, gimatyaplu klunerni Goyakalu galukanru kigleru gigleretkaluru mmagatikatu.
Kristomanepsojitkaka

Giyagni gimutlewlu nenekikoluya, wane nchingi satkaka gixa yegi gwachri, gi wane rixinri pnute ralixkotinwa, seyni kanshinikanurupni yanshinikanyegitinwa wa Goyakalu wane rixa yagotletyawaklu satkaka galixle.
Gi rixanu wane rixpokota. Satkakmane waneywu gixo manchipsojitkaka, seyni gi wa pejnuruneko waneko pixka gixa kamrureta koxa.
Waneko pixka wixa pamanepjewu Kristoya, ga wa pejnurunekwu pamanepjepsojitwu pimrineymananuko.
Gi rixanu waneywu pnumnu gixachri genekashlu, rixyawakni wa gimutlewlu wenekikolu. Wa tokanchi geneklewatachinwu wixinri wane rixa yagotletka galixlu wixanupa, wanepotuko wixanu.
Wa kamrurewatachri rixinri, wane rixa kamrurewletanu. Wa yimaklewatachri rixinri, wane rixa yimaklewletanu.
Wa kgiykolewakleru wane rixa giykolewletanu. Geneka salewatachri machipetupni. Girukotlewatachri jmererupni. Kgetwamonreru rumuwleya renekashlewatanu.
Xirnanshinikanutachinepgi
Gi gixasha galuklewletanu. Gagnanutanru mugletu. Kigleru gomkagitanu.
Galuukakanu gixkakluko moletkakachine pixka. Satkaka gkagwakpirkakanu gixkakluko.
Gi wa mmerenepgi. Xirnanshinikanutachinepgi. Gitsrukaachi wayegrenepgi.
Gimjikachinepgi kagwaakaluruya. Gakotanshinikanutachinepgi nsalewninriya. Gomkagitanru gagjigognere.
Gapikanna magatinrinwa kpashirine. Machipepjingognenanupgi.
Kigleruya paalixinri gektutu
Giglenshinikanyegjixanna gkojwakjene. Giglenshinikanyegjixlewatanu. Gi gkamakpiirewatanu.
Gimuwatanu wa gimuwatachineyma. Nchiyagatanu chiyagatachineyma.
Panshinikanurunepgi. Gi galixkotinwa. Mpogireneymapgi. Gi wa kgimatkalewaklerune gkagwakanshinikanutinwa.
Gi wa gapnutanru gektutu gixjeru gektutuya. Gkamrutanru kigleru pejnuruneko yine getanu.
Rumkata wane gixkota, wa gixa gimkata wane gixletyawaka, kigle gwalepgi pejnuruneko yineyma.
Nalukanune, gi gixananuko gapnuyegitinwa, seyni getashlewatanu jgekanchi waneyapa. Gi rixanu kayongalutkani,
Giyagni, wa nachichinipa wa pkamnixjeru peneka nikletanru. Ronunnagatewatinipa peneka giiretanru. Wane pixini chichmero pmoljiwutanru.
Gi wa gektutu gaalixanyi seyni wa kigleruya paalixinri gektutu.
